name: ask-tutor
title: Ask Tutor
description: Ask about a lesson or failing test with selected context.
useCases: During an exercise, a student asks about a selected code fragment. The app sends the question and its context to the tutoring service.
While investigating a mistake, a learner removes an irrelevant source before submitting and reads a reply citing the relevant lesson passage.
task: Ask about a lesson or failing test with selected context.

models.TutorAnswer: type TutorAnswer = { text: string; citation?: Citation };

behavior: onAsk receives the question and the remaining sources from context. Return a Promise with text and an optional citation. Omitting the handler enables the demo reply.
